title: Update application theme to professional modern aesthetic

requirements.summary: Update global CSS configuration to implement professional color palette with navy, charcoal, slate grays, and white in OKLCH format
acceptanceCriteria: Color palette uses navy, charcoal, slate grays, and white
Colors are defined in OKLCH format for consistency
Both light and dark mode variables are updated
All CSS custom properties maintain proper naming conventions

file_operations.description: Replace the current warm education-focused color palette (amber, orange, teal) with professional colors: navy (#1e3a5f), charcoal (#2c2c2c), slate grays (#64748b, #475569), and white (#ffffff). Convert these hex values to OKLCH format and update all CSS custom properties for both light and dark modes. Maintain the existing OKLCH color space structure and variable naming conventions.

requirements.summary: Update Tailwind configuration to align with the new professional color scheme
acceptanceCriteria: Tailwind color tokens map to the new professional CSS variables
All existing color references are updated to maintain consistency
No broken color references in the configuration

file_operations.description: Update the Tailwind color configuration to reference the updated CSS variables for navy, charcoal, slate, and white tones. Ensure all color tokens in the theme.extend.colors section align with the new professional palette defined in index.css. Verify that primary, secondary, accent, and other color mappings use the updated variable names.

requirements.summary: Refine typography to create clear visual hierarchy suitable for professional SaaS platform
acceptanceCriteria: Typography scale creates clear visual hierarchy
Headings use appropriate font weights (600-700)
Body text maintains optimal readability
Line heights are optimized for professional layouts

file_operations.description: Update the typography configuration in theme.extend to create a professional hierarchy. Adjust font sizes, weights (ensuring headings use 600-700), and line heights for optimal readability. Configure heading scales (h1-h6) with clear size distinctions and ensure body text uses comfortable line-height values (1.6-1.8 for body, tighter for headings).

requirements.summary: Update Layout component with professional theme styling and refined spacing
acceptanceCriteria: Header and navigation use the professional color scheme
Spacing is refined and consistent
Mobile menu styling matches the professional aesthetic
Footer maintains the updated theme

file_operations.description: Apply professional theme styling to the header, navigation, mobile menu, and footer. Update background colors to use navy/charcoal from the new palette, refine spacing for better visual balance, and ensure navigation links use appropriate hover states with the professional color scheme. Update mobile menu overlay and animations to match the modern aesthetic.

requirements.summary: Update HomePage with polished professional styling and improved visual hierarchy
acceptanceCriteria: Hero section uses professional colors and improved spacing
Feature cards have clean, modern appearance
Call-to-action buttons follow the new design system
Overall layout conveys trustworthiness and expertise

file_operations.description: Update the hero section background, headings, and descriptions to use the navy/charcoal/slate palette. Refine spacing throughout for better visual hierarchy. Update feature cards with clean borders, subtle shadows, and professional color accents. Ensure CTA buttons use the primary navy color with appropriate hover states. Apply refined typography weights and sizes for professional appearance.

requirements.summary: Update AnalysisFlow component with professional styling for resume upload and job role selection
acceptanceCriteria: Step indicators use professional styling
Form elements follow the new design system
Cards have clean, business-appropriate appearance
Spacing and layout improve readability

file_operations.description: Apply professional theme styling to the two-step flow interface. Update step indicators with navy/slate colors, refine card backgrounds and borders to use subtle grays, improve spacing between sections, and ensure form elements use the new professional color scheme. Update heading typography with appropriate weights for clear hierarchy.

requirements.summary: Update AnalysisDashboard with professional theme styling for data visualization and metrics
acceptanceCriteria: Match percentage display uses professional styling
Chart containers have clean, modern appearance
Cards and sections maintain visual consistency
Color scheme conveys business professionalism

file_operations.description: Update the dashboard layout with professional styling. Apply navy/charcoal colors to card backgrounds and borders, refine the match percentage display with professional color accents, update chart container styling with clean borders and appropriate spacing, and ensure all sections use the refined typography scale. Improve visual hierarchy with consistent card patterns.

requirements.summary: Update chart components to use professional color palette for data visualization
acceptanceCriteria: Chart colors use professional palette
Data remains clearly distinguishable
Color choices enhance rather than distract from insights
Charts maintain accessibility standards

file_operations.description: Update the pie chart colors to use professional palette: navy for matching skills, slate gray for missing skills. Ensure colors maintain sufficient contrast and meet WCAG accessibility standards. Update legend and label styling to match the professional theme.

Update the bar chart colors to use professional palette variations: navy and complementary slate tones for different categories. Ensure bars remain clearly distinguishable while maintaining professional appearance. Update axis labels and grid styling to use subtle slate grays.

Update the bar chart colors to use professional palette with navy primary color and slate variations for different proficiency levels. Ensure color progression maintains clarity and accessibility. Update chart styling including axis labels, legends, and tooltips to match the professional aesthetic.

requirements.summary: Update GapAnalysisResults component with professional card styling and refined badges
acceptanceCriteria: Skill cards use professional styling
Badge colors align with the new palette
Visual hierarchy clearly distinguishes matching from missing skills
Layout maintains professional appearance

file_operations.description: Update skill cards with professional borders, backgrounds (subtle slate/white), and refined spacing. Update skill badges to use navy for matching skills and slate gray for missing skills. Improve typography with appropriate font weights and sizes. Ensure the two-column layout maintains visual balance with the professional color scheme.

requirements.summary: Update RecommendationsDisplay component with professional styling for course and project recommendations
acceptanceCriteria: Recommendation cards have professional appearance
Course links are clearly styled and accessible
Project suggestions use refined typography
Overall layout maintains business aesthetic

file_operations.description: Apply professional styling to recommendation cards using subtle slate backgrounds and clean borders. Update course link styling with navy color and appropriate hover states. Refine typography for project suggestions with clear hierarchy. Ensure success message uses professional color accents when no gaps exist.

requirements.summary: Update AdminPanel component with professional admin interface styling
acceptanceCriteria: Admin interface conveys authority and professionalism
Form controls use refined styling
Job role cards maintain clean appearance
Action buttons follow the professional design system

file_operations.description: Update admin panel with professional styling using navy/charcoal for headers and key sections. Apply refined card styling to job role displays with subtle slate backgrounds and clean borders. Update CRUD operation buttons to use primary navy for add/edit actions and appropriate slate tones for delete operations. Improve spacing and typography hierarchy throughout.

requirements.summary: Update JobRoleForm component with professional form styling
acceptanceCriteria: Form inputs have professional appearance
Skill management UI uses clean styling
Validation errors are clearly visible but not jarring
Submit buttons follow the design system

file_operations.description: Apply professional styling to form inputs using subtle slate borders and clean focus states with navy accents. Update skill management interface (add/remove skill buttons and skill list) with refined spacing and professional colors. Style validation error messages with appropriate color and typography that maintains professional appearance. Ensure submit button uses primary navy color.

requirements.summary: Update ResumeUpload component with professional styling for drag-and-drop zone
acceptanceCriteria: Upload zone has clean, inviting appearance
Progress indicators use professional styling
Error messages maintain professional tone and appearance
Success states are clearly communicated

file_operations.description: Update drag-and-drop zone styling with subtle slate border, clean background, and navy accent on hover/active states. Apply professional styling to upload progress indicators using navy for the progress bar. Style validation error messages with appropriate slate/red tones that maintain professional appearance. Update success state styling with subtle green accent that fits the professional palette.

requirements.summary: Update JobRoleSelector component with professional card styling for job role options
acceptanceCriteria: Job role cards have modern, professional appearance
Selection states are clearly indicated
Skill badges use refined styling
Loading states maintain professional aesthetic

file_operations.description: Apply professional styling to job role cards with clean borders, subtle slate backgrounds, and navy accents for selected states. Update skill badges with refined colors using slate tones. Improve hover states with subtle transitions. Ensure loading states use professional spinner styling with navy color. Refine typography and spacing throughout.

requirements.summary: Update button components with consistent professional button design system
acceptanceCriteria: Primary buttons use navy with appropriate hover states
Secondary buttons use charcoal or slate styling
All buttons maintain consistent sizing and spacing
Interactive states (hover, active, disabled) are clearly defined

file_operations.description: Update button styling to use navy for login action and slate/charcoal for logout action. Apply refined hover states with appropriate color darkening. Ensure consistent padding, border-radius, and typography. Update disabled state with professional opacity and cursor styling.

Update button styling to use professional navy primary color with clean hover state. Ensure loading state uses appropriate spinner styling in white. Maintain consistent sizing, spacing, and typography with other primary buttons in the application.

requirements.summary: Update ProfileSetupModal component with professional modal styling
acceptanceCriteria: Modal has clean, professional appearance
Form fields use refined styling
Layout maintains optimal spacing
Save button follows the design system

file_operations.description: Apply professional styling to the modal overlay and container using charcoal overlay with appropriate opacity. Update form fields with subtle slate borders and navy focus states. Refine spacing between form elements for optimal readability. Ensure save button uses primary navy color with appropriate hover state. Update modal header typography with professional weight and size.
